name: Data Analysis
description: A goal-driven report for CSV, TSV, spreadsheet, Parquet, and tabular JSON sources that emphasizes patterns, comparisons, relationships, anomalies, and limitations.

data_requirements.description: Materialize rows, fields, and computed evidence sufficient to answer the user's objective from actual data values.
calculation_hints: Preserve the fields needed for objective-relevant distributions, comparisons, relationships, anomalies, and limitations.
Do not substitute row count, column count, or schema description for analysis of values.
Apply only filters confirmed by the user objective or execution spec.

fallback.message: Explain that objective-relevant value evidence is unavailable.

data_requirements.description: Profile material quality issues only when they affect interpretation of the objective.
calculation_hints: Focus on missingness, duplicates, invalid values, or coverage gaps that can change the conclusion.
Do not create a quality section when no material issue is present.

fallback.message: Omit quality details when they are not material.

sections.title: Overview
sections.purpose: Answer the objective and surface the most important value-based findings.

blocks.title: Executive Summary
instructions: Lead with a direct answer to the objective and the strongest observed patterns.
Do not lead with row count, column count, or field names alone.
Keep the opening proportionate to the objective and evidence complexity.

blocks.title: Key Findings
instructions: Present distinct comparisons, relationships, anomalies, or limitations.
Keep each item tied to observed values.

sections.title: Data at a Glance
sections.purpose: Provide a compact set of overview measures that materially helps answer the objective.

blocks.title: Overview
instructions: Select only metrics that orient the reader or materially support the objective.
Prefer objective-relevant measures; use structural measures only when they add necessary context.

sections.title: Focused Analysis
sections.purpose: Pair the most useful visual evidence with concise interpretation.

blocks.title: Primary Comparison

chart_slot.intent: Visualize the most informative comparison, trend, or distribution for the objective.

fallback.message: No meaningful quantitative comparison is available.

instructions: Use the visual form that best fits the bound evidence.

blocks.title: Interpretation
instructions: Explain the implication of the comparison and material caveats.
Do not repeat chart labels or narrate chart mechanics.

sections.title: Quality and Caveats
sections.purpose: Explain only the data limitations that materially affect interpretation.

blocks.title: Material Data Issues
instructions: Include only fields with interpretation-relevant issues.

blocks.title: Limitations and Next Checks
instructions: Tie every limitation or next check to observed evidence.
Do not add generic data-cleaning advice.
